corrected_code:
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import LegalAgreement
from .serializers import HistoricalLegalAgreementSerializer

class HistoricalAgreementDetailView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, history_id):
        historical_record = get_object_or_404(
            LegalAgreement.history.model,
            history_id=history_id
        )
        if historical_record.organization != request.user.organization:
            raise PermissionDenied("You do not have permission to inspect this agreement revision.")
        serializer = HistoricalLegalAgreementSerializer(historical_record)
        return Response(serializer.data)
